facts: (1) Template views/components under frontend/admin/src/: ONLY src/views/TemplatesView.vue and src/components/TemplatePreview.vue. NO separate studio/ or designer page files — designer is an in-page overlay in TemplatesView (.designer-mask, .designer, .designer-header, .designer-body, .designer-sidebar). No other *template* / *studio* / *designer* source files under src/.

(2) Router file: frontend/admin/src/main.ts. Routes are generated: protectedRoutes = adminNavigation.map(item => ({ path, name, component, meta: { permission, title, description, navigationGroup } })). Exact template route record (from admin-navigation item): path '/templates', name 'templates', component lazy () => import('./views/TemplatesView.vue'), meta.permission 'storefront:template:manage', meta.title '商城模板', meta.description '编辑 PC 与 H5 共用的商城模板草稿并安全发布。', meta.navigationGroup 'merchandising'. Plus public /login and catch-all redirect '/'. History: createWebHistory(import.meta.env.BASE_URL).

(3) Menu/nav definition: frontend/admin/src/admin-navigation.ts export const adminNavigation. Template item: name 'templates', path '/templates', label '商城模板', shortLabel '模板', icon '模', group 'merchandising', permission 'storefront:template:manage'. App.vue: adminNavigation.filter(item => item.group === group.id && can(item.permission)). session.ts can(permission) checks adminSession.current.permissions.includes(permission). Permission display label in src/localization.ts permissionText: 'storefront:template:manage' => '商城模板管理' (permissionLabel()). Exact permission code for templates: storefront:template:manage.

(4) API client: NO dedicated template API module. Shared client frontend/admin/src/api.ts export async function adminApi<T>(path, init) → fetch(`/api/v1/admin${path}`). All template endpoints and TS types live inline in TemplatesView.vue. Types: PresetType, TemplateRow, Tokens, SectionSettings, Section, Editor. Endpoints: GET /storefront/templates; POST /storefront/templates; POST /storefront/templates/:id/duplicate; PUT /storefront/templates/:id (body name, designTokensJson, layoutJson, expectedVersion); POST /storefront/templates/:id/publish; DELETE /storefront/templates/:id (archive). TemplatePreview.vue has local Tokens/Section props only.

(5) Tests covering template features: frontend/admin/tests/admin-pages.test.mjs — (a) navigation registry expects ['/templates','storefront:template:manage']; (b) dedicated test 'storefront template studio supports presets, dirty protection, narrow-screen tabs and safe publishing' sources TemplatesView.vue, TemplatePreview.vue, admin-navigation.ts, styles.css. frontend/admin/tests/admin-localization.test.mjs test name 'admin templates do not directly render...' is UNRELATED (means Vue SFC templates). No template hits in admin-workbench.test.mjs or rules-safety.test.mjs.

(6) Case-insensitive 'template' under src/ (~192 hits): FEATURE — admin-navigation.ts (templates nav), localization.ts (storefront:template:manage), TemplatesView.vue (feature logic + .template-* CSS + designer), TemplatePreview.vue (feature preview). UNRELATED — nearly every .vue file: Vue SFC <template> / </template> / <template #slot>; CSS grid-template-columns/rows in styles.css and many view scoped styles. No other modules import TemplatesView or TemplatePreview (only TemplatesView imports TemplatePreview; navigation lazy-imports TemplatesView).

package.json scripts (frontend/admin/package.json): 'dev' = vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5174; 'build' = vue-tsc -b && vite build; 'build:container' = vue-tsc -b && vite build --base=/admin/; 'typecheck' = vue-tsc -b; 'test' = node --test tests/*.test.mjs.
Vite base: vite.config.ts has NO base option (default '/'). Container base path only via build:container CLI flag --base=/admin/. Router uses import.meta.env.BASE_URL.
